MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 3 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 11
   C. 9
   D. 3

2. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

3. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 25

4. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 4

5. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 50
   D. 14

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

7. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 5

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 1

9. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

10. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 15

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
